This is the story of how journalists uncovered a secretive social media campaign designed to lure young Americans to the Polymarket prediction market platform.

It’s largely based on investigations by The Wall Street Journal and Politico. Please check them out:
https://www.wsj.com/business/media/polymarket-social-media-bets-prediction-market-441cdeb5 
https://www.politico.com/news/2026/06/05/polymarket-paid-political-influencers-00932789

Watch Christophe’s Tunnel Vision video about prediction markets: https://youtu.be/E_V7m_lnybY?si=WZK4CIgd2JZtY_NB 


Special thanks to Katherine Long at The Wall Street Journal plus Maya Kaufman and Jason Beeferman at Politico. Also thanks to Ted Bradford.
